summary: WatchNexus v1.2.4 Bug Fixes Verified - All reported issues resolved. Home page loads correctly with hero banner and trending content, Libraries populate with scanned media, Browse button opens folder browser modal, API URL configuration works for both development and production modes.
critical_code_review_comments: API URL configuration fix verified: /app/frontend/src/lib/config.js exports BACKEND_URL with fallback to empty string for same-origin requests
API service uses correct BACKEND_URL fallback: /app/frontend/src/services/api.js line 5
AuthContext correctly imports API_URL from config: /app/frontend/src/context/AuthContext.js line 3
SettingsPage correctly uses BACKEND_URL from config: /app/frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.js line 18
Library scanning working: Test Movies library has 3 items (Interstellar, Matrix, Inception) at /tmp/testmovies
seed_data_creation: Test Movies library exists at /tmp/testmovies with 3 scanned media files (Interstellar.2014.1080p.mkv, The.Matrix.1999.1080p.BluRay.mp4, Inception.2010.720p.mp4)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All v1.2.4 bug fixes verified. Login with test@test.com/password. Home page shows hero banner with TMDB trending content and 'Recently Added' section with 3 movies from Test Movies library. Settings -> Library tab shows 'Add Library' button and Browse button opens folder browser modal. API URL configuration supports both development (preview URL) and production (same-origin) modes.

home_page.recently_added_section: Shows 3 NEW items from scanned library
home_page.trending_section: Shows 'Trending This Week' with movie cards

library_settings.add_library_form: Shows Library Name, Media Type dropdown, Folder Path input
library_settings.browse_button: Opens folder browser modal with FolderSearch icon

folder_browser_modal.title: 'Browse for Folder' modal
folder_browser_modal.media_file_indicator: Shows '3 media files in this folder' for /tmp/testmovies

library_page.libraries_section: Shows 'Test Movies' library card with scan/delete buttons
library_page.recently_added: Shows 'Recently Added' section with Interstellar, Matrix, Inception

authentication.successful_login: Redirects to dashboard with 'Welcome back!' toast

issue_1_blank_home_page.description: Home page was blank in production build
issue_1_blank_home_page.root_cause: process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL was baked into production builds, causing API calls to fail in standalone mode
issue_1_blank_home_page.fix: Added fallback to empty string in config.js for same-origin requests
issue_1_blank_home_page.verification: Home page now loads hero banner, trending content, and recently added section

issue_2_libraries_not_populating.description: Libraries were not populating with media
issue_2_libraries_not_populating.verification: Test Movies library shows 3 items, Recently Added section displays Interstellar, Matrix, Inception

issue_3_missing_browse_button.description: Browse button was missing from Library settings
issue_3_missing_browse_button.verification: Browse button (FolderSearch icon) present in Add Library form, opens folder browser modal

mocked_apis.note: All APIs are real implementations using SQLite database and TMDB API
